text:
pagerbot: PagerDuty -> HIGH: inference-gateway (prod-eu-west1) experiencing sustained 5xx spike (>15% traffic)
pagerbot: Alert details: 5xx rate = 18.4% over 2m, p50 latency +30ms, potential customer impact. Pager: @emily (oncall)
emily (oncall): acked — i'm looking now. grabbing logs and checking deploys :eyes:
sam (sre): i'm on call too. any recent rollouts in eu-west1?
raj (infra): I see a canary rollout finishing ~3m ago for the edge-proxy image. health checks look flappy for a subset of hosts.
maria (support): we already have 3 customer pings mentioning intermittent 502s on EU. escalating to account leads.
emily (oncall): ok, first triage: 1) confirm if this is infra or model backpressure 2) check k8s pod restarts 3) fallback routing status
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary deploy edge-proxy v12.4 -> completed 3m ago. No automatic rollback.
sam (sre): checking pod statuses: multiple inference-gateway pods showing Liveness failures and high connection resets.
raj (infra): starting to drain suspect nodes and re-schedule. increasing target replicas for gateway pool by +30% (kubectl scale --replicas=26 svc/inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1)
emily (oncall): rolling back canary? or isolate?
sam (sre): recommended: isolate canary subset to cordon nodes, rollback if errors persist. But let's also enable fallback routing to smaller model variant to reduce load.
emily (oncall): enabling fallback routing policy now: set route.priority=low->model-small, TTL 5m. command: `rwctl routing update inference-gateway --fallback model-small --percent 20`
ops-bot: routing service: fallback policy applied, 20% traffic->model-small for inference-gateway in eu-west1
maria (support): flagging customers: message drafted to affected accounts, ETA 30m for mitigation.
sam (sre): seeing a drop in 5xx in the last 30s on nodes that were rescheduled. overall 5xx from 18.4% -> 12.1%
emily (oncall): good. continue to monitor. can we warm KV cache for hot prefixes?
raj (infra): launching cache-warm job across EU pool: `k run kv-warm --image=redwood/kv-warm:stable --restart=OnFailure -- ...` starting 10 workers.
sam (sre): also temporarily reduce max_batch_size on gateway to lower peak mem usage: updated config -> `max_batch_size: 64` (was 128). rolling config out to 25% canary first.
emily (oncall): note in the thread if any rollback happens. also collecting traces for correlation-id trace-12345. attaching logs snippet:
```\n2026-03-14T02:15:21Z inference-gateway[pod-77] ERROR grpc: failed to push request: upstream 502 connection reset\n2026-03-14T02:15:22Z inference-gateway[pod-77] WARN high-kv-cache-miss prefix=chat:conv:abc\n```
sam (sre): those resets line up with increased OOMKills on one node. infra is evicting pods due to host memory pressure.
raj (infra): investigating host-side memory leakers, pulling metrics from node-exporter. temporarily bumped instance size for 3 suspect hosts (migrate to m6i-large).
maria (support): Customer comms sent to 3 accounts. telling them we are mitigating and will follow up with RCA.
emily (oncall): 5xx rate now 7.9% and trending down. continuing to hold fallback for 10m and monitor.
ops-bot: autopager: no further PD escalations. all acked.
sam (sre): plan for postmortem: 1) root cause of memory pressure 2) why canary hit production nodes without rollback 3) improve runbook for fallback route thresholds 4) test KV cache warmup during deploys
emily (oncall): assigning action items: @raj to investigate host memory leak, @sam to lead postmortem and collect traces, @maria to consolidate customer impact timeline.
raj (infra): ack. starting heap/profile dumps collection. ETA 2h for first artifacts.
maria (support): collecting customer logs/requests, will add to incident doc.
emily (oncall): closing page for now — we'll keep thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: Incident closed (auto) — no active PD alerts for inference-gateway in prod-eu-west1.
